title: Oyatie microservice manifest
description: Machine-readable per-microservice manifest. Authoritative consolidation of PRD bounded-context list, catalog crates, contract files, capability catalog (with risk classification), OpenSLO targets, in-flight Implementation Plans (GA acceptance only), regulatory packs, LTS pins, ADRs (repo + microservice scope), hyperscaler invariant alert coverage, audit-chain seal events, and OpenBao secrets substrate. Authored per ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout + Sweep-F machine-readable artifact directive.

graphql.description: GraphQL SDL/resolver contract projection paths generated or validated from the service shared contract source of truth.

source.description: Rust-native shared contract source paths that generate or validate REST/OpenAPI, gRPC/Protobuf, and GraphQL projections.

ontology_projections.description: ADR-0145 Invariant 3 — µservices owning canonical entities declare projection targets in Ontology. Empty array is permitted for µservices that own no canonical entities. Validated by oya-check-ontology-projection-coverage (advisory mode pending the strict-mode parser per registry/placeholder-debt/adr-follow-ups.yaml#adr-0145-ontology-projection-validator).

data_classes_processed.description: ADR-0156 — UNION of per-BC `data_classes_owned`. Aggregated into specs/microservices/pii-registry.json by the DSR cascade. Per ADR-0008 the canonical taxonomy is shared with crates/oya-data-boundary-kernel.

rpo_rto.description: ADR-0152 — Per-µservice RPO/RTO declaration (five-tier model). Aggregated into specs/microservices/rpo-rto-targets.json. Coexists with the newer ADR-0343 `dr` block (below): `rpo_rto` is the legacy five-tier ergonomic; `dr` is the canonical two-layer (µservice declared + per-pack floor) matrix. New microservices SHOULD declare `dr`; existing `rpo_rto` declarations remain compatible until each microservice migrates under Wave 15W-DR-Matrix-declaration.

dr.description: ADR-0343 — Canonical per-µservice DR (disaster recovery) declaration. Required: rto_p99_seconds, rpo_p99_seconds, multi_region_active_active, backup_substrate, failover_runbook. Optional: dr_tier (T1..T4 ergonomic shorthand from ADR-0241 reconciled per ADR-0343 §D-8), last_drill_evidence_id (per /specs/dr-business-continuity.json#manifest_block), replication_shape (per /specs/dr-business-continuity.json#tiers[*].replication_shape). Effective tenant DR contract = MIN over (this declaration, all-applicable-pack floors from /specs/compliance-pack-floors.json) for rto/rpo; OR over multi_region flags; SHORTEST cadence across drill cadences. Planned enforcement (advisory until crates land) by oya-check-dr-manifest-block + oya-check-dr-pack-floor-satisfaction + oya-check-dr-multi-region-required + oya-check-dr-runbook-presence + oya-check-dr-backup-substrate-allowlist + oya-check-dr-drill-evidence-fresh per ADR-0343 §E.

rto_p99_seconds.description: Declared p99 recovery-time-objective in whole seconds.

rpo_p99_seconds.description: Declared p99 recovery-point-objective in whole seconds. 0 = no data loss tolerated (active-active or synchronous replication).

multi_region_active_active.description: True = active-active across >= 2 regions; false = active-passive, single-region, or backup-restore. Effective value with pack overlay = OR of this flag and every applicable pack's multi_region_required flag per ADR-0343 §D-4.

backup_substrate.description: Canonical allowlisted backup substrates per ADR-0343 §D-5. Planned enforcement by oya-check-dr-backup-substrate-allowlist (advisory until the crate lands).

failover_runbook.description: Path relative to the microservice root, pointing to a markdown file inside the microservice's runbooks/ directory. MUST resolve at admission; planned enforcement by oya-check-dr-runbook-presence (advisory until the crate lands).

dr_tier.description: Optional ergonomic tier shorthand from ADR-0241. When declared, the numeric fields MUST satisfy the tier's defaults from /specs/dr-business-continuity.json#tiers per ADR-0343 §D-8 reconciliation.

last_drill_evidence_id.description: Audit-chain event ID demonstrating the runbook was last exercised. Age MUST be within effective drill cadence (SHORTEST cadence across tier-default and applicable pack drill_cadence_required) per ADR-0343 §D-6. Planned enforcement by oya-check-dr-drill-evidence-fresh (advisory until the crate lands).

multi_region_disposition.description: ADR-0158 / /specs/multi-region-disposition-canonical.json — Accepted per-µservice multi-region disposition declaration. The canonical spec marks this manifest field required and pairs it with a same-root `multi-region.md` companion document; this schema admits the field now so `additionalProperties=false` manifests can declare it while the corpus-wide readiness gate fills current oya/cloud roots and promotes hard-required enforcement through the future cloud-ci/Rust gate packet `multi-region-disposition`.

outbox_required.description: ADR-0153 — Whether the µservice MUST integrate the transactional outbox pattern. True for the five charter carriers (messenger, mail, social, tasks, calendar) first; expanding across all event-emitters.

mesh_layering.description: ADR-0148 layered service-mesh enrollment. Every µservice runs on Cilium L3/L4 (cilium_l4=true always) and Istio Ambient ztunnel mTLS (ambient_ztunnel=true always). The Tier-3 waypoint (ambient_waypoint) is per-µservice opt-in based on whether the µservice handles L7-policed traffic. Five µservices that handle L7-policed traffic at PR #143 landing declare ambient_waypoint=true: governance, foundry, audit-chain, application, workflow-studio. All others declare ambient_waypoint=false (default).

cilium_l4.description: Tier 1 — Cilium L3/L4 + CNI + Hubble flow observability. Always true per ADR-0148.

ambient_ztunnel.description: Tier 2 — Istio Ambient ztunnel mTLS via SPIFFE workload identity. Always true per ADR-0148.

ambient_waypoint.description: Tier 3 — Istio Ambient waypoint Envoy for L7 AuthorizationPolicy + Cedar ext_authz + response envelope shaping. Per-µservice opt-in. Default false. Required true for µservices handling L7-policed traffic (regulatory packs, sensitive ontology reads, canary routing).

north_south_only.description: Reserved for the api-gateway µservice per ADR-0182. When true, this µservice owns north-south ingress and MUST NOT enroll the east-west mesh (cilium_l4 + ambient_ztunnel become advisory rather than enforced).

storage.description: ADR-0196 / ADR-0197 — Object store + backup namespace. Advisory in PR #143; per-µservice population begins in PR-145+.

compute.description: ADR-0198 — Karpenter node-pool selection namespace. Advisory in PR #143.

finops.description: ADR-0199 — FinOps cost-attribution namespace. Advisory in PR #143.

data.description: ADR-0192/0193/0194/0195 — Data substrate namespaces (vector store, OLAP, timeseries, stream processing). Advisory in PR #143.

dimension.description: ADR-0192 dimension class. Closed enum or Custom(u32) escape hatch.

runtime.description: ADR-0200 — WASM runtime namespace. Advisory in PR #143.

comms.description: ADR-0201 — Communications (email/messaging) substrate namespace. Advisory in PR #143.

iac.description: ADR-0202 — IaC tier namespace. OpenTofu canonical; Terraform deprecated path during 90-day migration window.

i18n.description: ADR-0206 — Fluent ICU locale coverage namespace. Advisory in PR #143.

a11y.description: ADR-0207 — WCAG 2.2 AA coverage namespace. Advisory in PR #143.

realtime.description: ADR-0208 — Real-time transport tier namespace. Advisory in PR #143.

compliance.description: ADR-0209 — Compliance evidence pipeline namespace. Advisory in PR #143.

capacity_model.description: ADR-0340 — Per-µservice machine-readable capacity declaration driving autoscaler (ADR-0198 Karpenter) + cell sizing (ADR-0009 + ADR-0248) + FinOps projection (ADR-0174 + ADR-0199) + cellular placement determinism (ADR-0333 oya-shuffle-sharding). Required for every workload-producing µservice; optional for spec-only µservices. cell_placement_class is the ADR-0248 cellular criticality numbering (Tier-0 = highest blast-radius / most isolated) and is DISTINCT from ADR-0338 pod_runtime_tier (admission/isolation primitive); the two axes co-vary per ADR-0340 D-6 table. Advisory at landing; per-µservice declaration sequenced as the 15U-Capacity-Model-declaration sub-wave under ADR-0328.

baseline_cpu_per_tenant.description: vCPU at steady state per active tenant (decimal; e.g., 0.1 = 100 milli-vCPU).

baseline_ram_per_tenant.description: MiB at steady state per active tenant (integer; e.g., 256).

storage_per_tenant.description: GB at steady state per active tenant (integer; 0 permitted for stateless µservices).

valkey.description: Valkey TCP connections per active tenant per ADR-0336.

postgres.description: PostgreSQL connections per active tenant (typically via PgBouncer transaction pool).

outbound_http.description: Outbound HTTP/3 + HTTP/2 + HTTP/1.1 connections to upstream µservices per active tenant per ADR-0253.

scaling_dimension.description: Closed enum per ADR-0340 D-3. Expansion requires ADR amendment.

cell_placement_class.description: ADR-0248 cellular criticality numbering. Tier-0 = Foundation (cloud-iam/cloud-kms/audit-chain primary/payments-pci); Tier-1 = Substrate; Tier-2 = Capability; Tier-3 = Application; Tier-4 = Edge.

tenant_class_deltas.description: Optional per-tenant-class overrides per ADR-0330 demo_trial vs paid composable billing components. REQUIRED when the µservice serves both tenant classes per ADR-0331 §D-8.

compliance_pack_overrides.description: Optional per-compliance-pack stricter floors per ADR-0251.

notes.description: Free-text justification of declared values; recommended for substance-bar evidence per ADR-0322.

sustainability_emission_model.description: ADR-0344 D-2 — Advisory per-µservice sustainability emission model declaration. Workload-emitting µservices declare this top-level block before per-service fanout; values are bespoke per service and do not create a live FinOps, billing, OpenCost/FOCUS, regulator-export, or cost-readiness claim until ADR-0344 is Accepted or explicitly promoted. The schema admits the authority shape only; oya-check-sustainability-emission-model owns report-only/template-stamp refusal semantics before any future BLOCKER promotion.

pod_runtime_tier_ref.description: Reference to this manifest's pod_runtime_tier declaration; canonical value is self.pod_runtime_tier unless an authority-approved source ref is needed.

cpu_watts_per_vcpu_second.description: Positive, per-service calibrated CPU watt coefficient; ADR-0344 examples are illustrative and are not calibration evidence.

memory_watts_per_gib_second.description: Positive, per-service calibrated memory watt coefficient; ADR-0344 examples are illustrative and are not calibration evidence.

storage_watts_per_gib_hour.description: Non-negative, per-service calibrated storage watt coefficient for the service's storage profile.

network_watts_per_gib.description: Non-negative, per-service calibrated network watt coefficient for the service's network path.

tier_0_kata_clh.description: ADR-0344/ADR-0338 default overhead factor for Tier 0 Kata + Cloud Hypervisor; default is authority metadata, not per-service evidence.

tier_1_kata_clh.description: ADR-0344/ADR-0338 default overhead factor for Tier 1 Kata + Cloud Hypervisor; default is authority metadata, not per-service evidence.

tier_2_runc.description: ADR-0344/ADR-0338 default overhead factor for Tier 2 runc baseline; default is authority metadata, not per-service evidence.

tier_3_runc_edge.description: ADR-0344/ADR-0338 default overhead factor for Tier 3 edge/perf runc; default is authority metadata, not per-service evidence.

source.description: Current closed authority source. Additional sources require ADR/spec promotion before being admitted here.

binding.description: Repo path or authority-approved reference to the provider SKU/pricing binding; must not mutate invoices, chargeback, cost allocation, or live billing data.

pin_window_hours.description: Pricing pin window in hours; ADR-0344 example uses one hour.

workload_signal_source.description: Concrete service-specific signal family and source binding used to convert workload activity to watt-hours. A string source-ref is allowed for existing manifests; structured declarations must name the signal family.

emission_path_tests.description: Test, fixture, or target path(s) proving the service emission path populates cost, CO2, watt-hours, provider, and region within tolerance. Shape-only green is insufficient.

expected_watt_hours_per_request_p50_mwh.description: Per-service deterministic p50 fixture baseline in mWh; not a measured production claim without supporting IP/evidence.

expected_co2_grams_per_request_p50_at_gr.description: Per-service deterministic p50 CO2 fixture baseline at 400 gCO2/kWh; not a measured production claim without supporting IP/evidence.

tolerance_pct.description: Default ±20 percent tolerance per ADR-0344; per-service IPs may tighten with evidence.

not.description: Refuse the exact ADR-0344 illustrative block from D-2.2; per-service declarations must be bespoke and oya-check-sustainability-emission-model owns deeper template-stamp refusal.

pod_runtime_tier.description: ADR-0338 D-1.4 — Per-µservice pod runtime tier declaration. Integer in {0, 1, 2, 3}. Tier 0 = tenant-customer untrusted code (Kata + Cloud Hypervisor); Tier 1 = substrate µservices touching tenant data plane (Kata + Cloud Hypervisor); Tier 2 = first-party application µservices (runc) — default for new µservices; Tier 3 = edge / static / perf-critical (runc on dedicated edge nodepool). The tier integer maps to a RuntimeClass per ADR-0338 D-4 + a nodepool placement contract per D-3 + a Kubewarden-default admission policy per the 2026-05-25 launch directive, with Kyverno retained as a first-class adapter. REQUIRED for every µservice that produces a workload (Helm chart / Kubernetes Deployment / StatefulSet / Job / CronJob / podSpec); OPTIONAL for spec-only µservices that produce no workload (D-1.2 / D-1.3). The numbering aligns with ADR-0248 cellular criticality (Tier 0 = highest blast-radius / most isolated) and is DISTINCT from but CO-VARIES WITH ADR-0340 capacity_model.cell_placement_class per ADR-0340 D-6. Planned enforcement by oya-check-pod-runtime-tier (advisory until the crate lands; REPORT-ONLY at landing → BLOCKER after corpus-wide declaration sub-wave 15S-Pod-Runtime-Tier-declaration lands) + Kubewarden-default admission policy `enforce-pod-runtime-tier` with Kyverno first-class adapter parity.

pod_runtime_tier_justification.description: ADR-0338 D-1.5/D-1.6/D-1.7/D-1.8 — Bespoke per-µservice prose justification of the declared pod_runtime_tier value. REQUIRED for Tier 0 / Tier 1 / Tier 3 declarations per ADR-0338 D-1.10 (CI lane validates Tier 0 cites at least one A.2 surface, Tier 1 cites at least one A.3 surface, Tier 3 cites at least one A.5 surface); OPTIONAL for Tier 2 declarations (default; no citation required). Template-stamping is a P0 finding per ADR-0324 anti-script-authoring discipline.

pod_runtime_tier_surface_evidence.description: ADR-0338 D-1.5/D-1.6 — Per-µservice array of repo-relative paths citing the source files / IPs / runbooks that justify the declared pod_runtime_tier. Examples: src/ subdirectories implementing tenant-customer code execution (Tier 0); src/ subdirectories implementing key-derivation / audit-seal / token-signing (Tier 1); IPs documenting edge data-plane / packet-rate-bound hot-paths (Tier 3). REQUIRED for Tier 0 / Tier 1 / Tier 3 declarations; OPTIONAL for Tier 2.

consumes_upstream_oss.description: ADR-0345 B2.022 — Optional per-µservice array of upstream OSS dep_name strings the µservice directly consumes. Each value MUST match a `dep_name` field in /specs/oss-stewardship-registry.json#entries. The canonical aggregate of stewardship-class + CVE SLA + owner_team lives in the registry; this field is the per-µservice consumer-side index used by SBOM cross-reference + SOC2 CC2.3 / CC9.2 + ISO 27001 A.5.21 evidence pipelines. OPTIONAL at landing; promoted to required-when-µservice-consumes-non-trivial-upstreams under Wave 15X-OSS-stewardship per ADR-0345 B2.022. Planned enforcement by oya-check-oss-stewardship-registry-presence (advisory until the crate lands; planned to refuse corpus changes adding a direct upstream without a registry entry).

oss_stewardship_class_overrides.description: ADR-0345 B2.003 — Optional per-µservice overrides for niche upstreams not yet enumerated in the corpus-wide /specs/oss-stewardship-registry.json. Each entry declares a single upstream's stewardship_class (maintainer | contributor | consumer) with the per-class resourcing field. Per-µservice overrides are LOCAL — they do not propagate to other µservices; the corpus-wide registry remains the canonical aggregate per ADR-0345 D-1.5. Per-crate Maintainer declarations for the µservice's owned `oya-*` crates are NOT authored here; they are sequenced as Wave 15X-OSS-stewardship under ADR-0328 batch discipline per ADR-0345 A.8.1. The class vocabulary is the canonical 3-value enum {maintainer, contributor, consumer} per ADR-0345 B2.001/B2.007 — never `tier` per ADR-0345 §A.6 + lane `oya-governance-stewardship-class-vocabulary`.

dep_name.description: Canonical upstream identifier; matches Cargo.toml / Helm chart / OpenTofu provider name where applicable per ADR-0345 D-2.1.

stewardship_class.description: ADR-0345 B2.001/B2.007 — exactly one of three relationship labels. Never `tier`.

owner_team.description: Council / axis / ops taxonomy identifier per ADR-0345 B2.018 (e.g., council-architecture, axis-cloud-iac, ops-platform).

cve_sla_p0_days.description: Contributor-class only — P0 patch SLA in wall-clock days per ADR-0345 B2.010 (canonical floor: 7 for contributor).

cve_sla_p1_days.description: Contributor-class only — P1 patch SLA in wall-clock days per ADR-0345 B2.010 (canonical floor: 30 for contributor).

cve_sla_pin_update_days.description: Consumer-class only — pin-update SLA in wall-clock days per ADR-0345 B2.011 (canonical floor: 14 for consumer).

contribution_budget_dev_days_per_quarter.description: Contributor-class only — dev-days committed per quarter per ADR-0345 B2.014.

maintainer_engineering_time_percent.description: Maintainer-class only — percent of one FTE committed to maintenance over a rolling quarter per ADR-0345 B2.013.

audit_subscription_cost_usd.description: Consumer-class only — audit-subscription USD/year per ADR-0345 B2.015.

license.description: SPDX identifier; MUST NOT match the forbidden-license list per docs/standards/dependency-policy.md §2 + specs/forbidden-operations.json FO-09 (planned enforcement by oya-check-oss-stewardship-license-cross-check, advisory until the crate lands).

source_url.description: Upstream source URL per ADR-0345 D-2.1.

adr_provenance.description: ADR(s) justifying the dependency's inclusion per ADR-0345 B2.020.

mitigation_strategies.description: ADR-0345 D-2.5 closed enum of acceptable response patterns.

last_class_change_adr.description: Most recent ADR amendment changing the class per ADR-0345 B2.009.

notes.description: Bespoke per-upstream rationale per ADR-0322 substance-bar; template-stamping is a P0 finding per ADR-0324.

iac_module_invocations.description: ADR-0339 B2.016 — Per-µservice declaration of which shared OpenTofu IaC module-library primitives the µservice's per-context wrappers invoke. Each entry is a `<context>/<primitive>` path under microservices/cloud-iac/modules/. The five canonical contexts are aws-guest, oci-guest, on-prem, colo, oyatie-as-cloud-provider, with the sub-context oci-guest/always-free reserved for demo_trial-tenant-only primitives per `feedback_oci_always_free_maximization_2026_05_20`. OPTIONAL at landing (advisory until Wave 15Q-IaC-modules lands the ~50 canonical primitive bodies); promoted to required for any µservice that ships an `iac/` directory per ADR-0339 B2.017 migration buckets. Enforced by oya-check-iac-module-path-canonical + oya-check-iac-module-pin + oya-check-iac-module-signature-cosign + oya-check-iac-thin-wrapper-line-floor + oya-check-iac-module-catalog-discoverability + oya-check-iac-opentofu-only + oya-check-iac-shared-module-usage per ADR-0339 §E.

context.description: ADR-0339 B2.003 canonical five-context taxonomy + oci-guest/always-free sub-context.

primitive.description: Kebab-case primitive name per ADR-0339 D-1.3 (e.g., eks-cluster, oke-cluster, autonomous-db, oci-cache-valkey, valkey-cluster, shard-cell).

version_pin.description: Semantic-version tag scoped to the module-path per ADR-0339 D-3.1 / B2.005 (e.g., v1.4.0 or major-only v1). Unpinned consumption is refused by oya-check-iac-module-pin per ADR-0339 D-3.3.

cosign_attestation_digest.description: Optional sha256 cosign attestation digest pin per ADR-0181 + ADR-0339 B2.025.

tenant_class_scope.description: Optional per-invocation tenant_class scope per ADR-0331 §D-8.4/§D-8.6; oci-guest/always-free MUST be demo_trial; paid sub-variants MUST be paid.

tenant_version_pinning.description: ADR-0342 — Per-µservice api_versioning declaration AND tenant-pinning posture flag. The block enumerates the date-based versions the µservice exposes on its public boundary (OpenAPI 3.2.0 endpoints, AsyncAPI 3.1.0 channels, proto3 services exposed externally) plus the supported-window floor (N=3 versions × ≥180 days post-deprecation) plus the deprecation_calendar with per-version sunset-class-ADR cross-references plus the per-version OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/proto3 file path map. The block also declares whether the µservice supports per-tenant version pinning (per ADR-0342 D-5; tenant manifest authority lives at /specs/tenant-manifest-schema.json#api_version_pinning). Required for every µservice that exposes a public API; OPTIONAL for internal-only µservices that never appear at the api-gateway public boundary. Hyperscaler precedent: Stripe / Anthropic / OpenAI / AWS / Google Cloud / GitHub.

declared_versions.description: List of YYYY-MM-DD date strings (ISO-8601 calendar date; UTC; no time component) enumerating every public-API date version the µservice has ever published. Newest first.

default_version.description: YYYY-MM-DD date string the µservice returns when api-gateway receives a request without an explicit Oyatie-Version header and without a per-tenant override. MUST be a member of declared_versions.

supported_window_size.description: Number of date versions kept simultaneously supported (≥3 per ADR-0342 B2.012).

supported_window_minimum_days.description: Minimum days a version remains supported after deprecation before sunset (≥180 per ADR-0342 B2.013).

supports_per_tenant_pinning.description: ADR-0342 D-5 — Whether this µservice honors per-tenant overrides declared in tenant manifest api_version_pinning.per_microservice_overrides. True for ~all public-facing µservices; explicit false requires an exception ADR.

deprecation_calendar.description: Per-deprecated-version entries listing when each version was deprecated, when it sunsets to 410 Gone, the successor version, the paired sunset-class ADR, and the migration document.

public_surface_files.description: Per-version map of OpenAPI 3.2.0 / AsyncAPI 3.1.0 / proto3 source files. Keys are YYYY-MM-DD; values are paths under microservices/<name>/contracts/.

observability_trace_sampling_recipe.description: ADR-0210 — Trace sampling recipe (head + tail policies). Sibling to top-level observability keys; advisory in PR #143.

oya_workload_class.description: Shared 4-value workload classification per ADR-0197/0198/0199. Resolves the conflict C1 (three independent enums in PR #143 atomic-wiring plan).
